questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a bacteria used in the process of fermentation?
questions.solution:
• **Campylobacter **is not used in the process of **fermentation**.
 
• It is a genus of gram-negative bacteria, also known as curved bacteria
 
• It is considered to be the most common bacterial cause of human gastroenteritis in the world.
 
• Campylobacter bacteria are one of the main causes of diarrhea and foodborne illness.

questions.question: Karaga is one of the oldest and widely celebrated festivals of ________.
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which of the following is a Greek travel book listing the ports situated along the Indian coastline?
questions.solution:
• **The Periplus Maris Erythraei** was written by an Egyptian merchant around the middle of the first century CE.
 
• The last chapters describe the East Coast of India as far north as the mouth of the Ganges.
 
• The author’s pattern is to describe the lengths and conditions of the routes, and the imports and exports of the region.
 
• At present, the book has been digitalized as The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea: Travel and Trade in the Indian Ocean by a Merchant of the First Century.

questions.question: If a particular religious sect or community has been declared a "National Minority", which of the following is NOT an advantage its members can avail?

• The main advantages of this material are the** low deposition temperature**** **that offers the use of glass. 
 
• **Amorphous silicon (a-Si**) photoreceptor drums, which are long-life and highly durable products.

questions.question: Which of the following philosophies of Indian Philosophy (School of Thought) is often called "Indian Materialism"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option **3**, i.e **__Lokayat__.**

 
• Lokayat or the Indian Materialistic School focuses on materialism, and things beyond **Supernaturalism**.
 
• For them, the empirical reality is what counts and metaphysical reality is nothing but hogwash.
 
• "Eat, Sleep and Make Merry" is their motto.
 
• Other major India Philosophical Schools focus on metaphysical reality, and on concepts like God, Soul and Metaphysical World beyond the world of humans.

questions.question: Solid form of the element carbon is ______.
questions.solution:
• **Diamond** is the solid form of carbon. It is a natural mineral composed of carbon. It is the **hardest** natural substance.
 
• Each carbon atom in a **diamond** is surrounded by four other carbon atoms all of them connected through the strongest type of chemical bond(covalent bond).
 
• **Carbon dioxide** is a colorless and non-flammable gas at normal temperature and pressure.
 
• **Methane** (CH4) is a colorless, odorless, and highly flammable gas composed of one carbon atom and four hydrogen atoms.

questions.question: Which massive movement began after 1930 Dandi March?
questions.solution:
• The **Civil Disobedience Movement** began after 1930 Dandi March.
 
• This movement was led by **Mahatma Gandhi** when the British Government not given any response to his demands.
 
• In March 1930, Mahatma Gandhi began the historic **Dandi march** from **Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.**
 
• Civil Disobedience Movement involved: **Defiance of salt laws, Boycott of liquor and Non-payment of taxes and revenue.**
